\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 161-164 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R169-first-pass-words-from-chapters-161-164}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a label and a guide.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item modern, former, fresh, spicy, raw
  \item worried, with a cold, single, married, divorced
  \item a flat, a dining room, a balcony, a lock, a doorbell
  \item a passport, customs, a booking, a butcher's, a large river
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Modern? (\textbf{moderne}.) Former? (\textbf{ancien / ancienne}.) Fresh? (\textbf{frais / fraîche}.) Spicy? (\textbf{épicé / épicée}.) Raw? (\textbf{cru / crue}.) Worried? (\textbf{inquiet / inquiète}.) With a cold? (\textbf{enrhumé / enrhumée}.) Single? (\textbf{célibataire}.) Married? (\textbf{marié / mariée}.) Divorced? (\textbf{divorcé / divorcée}.) A flat? (\textbf{l'appartement}.) A dining room? (\textbf{la salle à manger}.) A balcony? (\textbf{le balcon}.) A lock? (\textbf{la serrure}.) A doorbell? (\textbf{la sonnette}.) A passport? (\textbf{le passeport}.) Customs? (\textbf{la douane}.) A booking? (\textbf{la réservation}.) A butcher's? (\textbf{la boucherie}.) A large river? (\textbf{le fleuve}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

A journalist? (\textbf{le journaliste}.) An architect? (\textbf{l'architecte}.) A dentist? (\textbf{le dentiste}.) A pharmacist? (\textbf{le pharmacien}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{la belle-mère}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{le gendre}.) A daughter-in-law? (\textbf{la belle-fille}.) A fiancé? (\textbf{le fiancé}.) A fiancée? (\textbf{la fiancée}.) A rule? (\textbf{la règle}.) Permission?
